target_customer: Consumers who want to play and create small AI generated apps and games; no paying customer identified
problem: Making an interactive app or game is hard for ordinary people, and there is no social feed where such creations can be shared and played.
business_model: Consumer social app; monetization not stated
product_category: Social feed of AI generated interactive mini apps

founders.name: Samagra Sharma
founders.background_notes: YC page: worked on multimodal content generation at Adobe Research and ML for network telemetry at UCSB.

founders.name: Agam Jain
education: IIT Bombay (research on nanowire FETs; degree not stated)
founders.background_notes: YC page: systems engineer at Qualcomm.

technical_complexity.rationale: Generating working mini apps from prompts and running them safely in a mobile feed needs solid engineering, though built on third party models.

defensibility.rationale: A creator and player network could build over time, but nothing stops larger platforms from adding the same feed.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Per 2026 coverage, Meta launched an AI mini game app called Pocket and YouTube has a Playables Builder; Sekai raised $20M. Whip has not been acquired per sources.

market_need_then: No dated evidence of demand at the Winter 2024 batch was found; the idea rode the generative AI wave.

identity.logo: Simple gray icon beside a plain Whip wordmark
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and short; each creation is called a whip

branding.community_and_virality: A Discord link is on the site; no other community evidence found.

brand_strength.rationale: Short memorable word and the own term whip for a post, but the name collides with Whip Media and Whip Around, and no press on the brand was found.

pivots.to: Whip, social feed of AI mini apps
pivots.why: Not stated; Seedtable describes Whip as a pivot from Tensorfuse. Exact date unknown.

outcome_analysis: Whip is an active Winter 2024 company built by the Tensorfuse founders, launching a mobile feed of AI made mini apps and later a web version. No funding disclosure, traction or exit was found. Large platforms and funded rivals entered the category in 2026, so the outcome is unresolved.
notes: Seedtable lists a seed dated 1 Jan 2024 with no amount; single aggregator, unverified. The pivot from Tensorfuse is from one aggregator. Search found no dated competitor near the batch (competitors found were 2026). TV Time shutdown news concerned Whip Media, an unrelated company.
